name: add_node_by_class
purpose: Spawn ANY concrete UK2Node subclass by class path via PlaceAndInit with a reflection-applied init map
cooked: refuses — cooked BPs have no graphs
prevents: PM-004 terminator AllocateDefaultPins double-pin trap (via hard denylist)
hazards: Hard denylist required: terminators, events, Timeline, MacroInstance, Composite/Tunnel, compiler-internal
Do NOT auto-load plugins for classes in unloaded modules — error naming the module
Init map must be applied BEFORE PlaceAndInit so AllocateDefaultPins sees it; then ReconstructNode
Schema compatibility gated via UEdGraphNode::IsCompatibleWithGraph — reject with schema reason

name: list_node_classes
purpose: Enumerate every loaded spawnable UK2Node subclass (name, module, abstract, denylist status, dedicated endpoint)

name: add_create_delegate
purpose: Spawn UK2Node_CreateDelegate wired to a target function so any existing function can bind to a dispatcher from any graph
prevents: Roadmap gap: dispatcher bindable only to freshly-authored custom events
hazards: IsValid is NOT exported (K2Node_CreateDelegate.h:59) — validate via GetDelegateSignature() != nullptr

name: add_async_action
purpose: Spawn UK2Node_AsyncAction family (latent proxy nodes for UBlueprintAsyncActionBase factories), currently unauthorable
hazards: Protected Proxy* UPROPERTYs must be set via reflection BEFORE PlaceAndInit/AllocateDefaultPins
Latent nodes are event-graph/macro-only — surface IsCompatibleWithGraph rejection verbatim

name: set_variable_type
purpose: Retype a member or local variable in place instead of remove+add which drops get/set nodes, flags and category
prevents: Roadmap: repair means remove+add, dropping every get/set node
hazards: REFUSE retype of a dispatcher's backing PC_MCDelegate variable (same footgun class as rename)
Dependent Blueprints recompile on next compile — document, not compile-heavy itself

name: create_macro
purpose: Create a user macro graph (entry/exit tunnels) so add_macro_instance can place user-authored macros
prevents: PM-004 avoided: AddMacroGraph creates tunnel terminators itself, never hand-spawned
hazards: Name collision must error, not silently rename (IsValidIdentifier + FindUniqueKismetName check)

name: remove_graph
purpose: Delete a macro or collapsed/extra graph; remove_function only searches FunctionGraphs so macros are permanent today
hazards: confirm=true gated; refuses ubergraph pages, delegate signature graphs, anim state-machine bound graphs
Pre-scan find_nodes to report orphanedInstances referencing the dead macro

name: reparent_component
purpose: Move an existing SCS component under a different parent (own-SCS, inherited-SCS, or native) without destroy/recreate
cooked: refuses — SCS lives only on uncooked UBlueprint
prevents: remove+add loses template property edits and nodes referencing the variable
hazards: Deliberately avoids USubobjectDataSubsystem::ReparentSubobjects — UI-locked, requires preview actor
Cycle check required: refuse if newParent is a descendant of the moved node
SetParent overloads are WITH_EDITOR-only (SCS_Node.h:184) — plugin is editor-only, note it

name: disassemble_function
purpose: Read-only Kismet bytecode disassembly of any UFunction, including cooked UBlueprintGeneratedClass functions
cooked: works — main purpose; bytecode is what the VM executes, present in cooked classes
hazards: Output cap when function omitted: per-function text with totalBytes guard, warn above ~1 MB
Never emit raw bytes — includeRaw only reports Script.Num() byte count

name: describe_anim_class
purpose: Structured read of a cooked or uncooked AnimBP generated class: baked state machines and anim-node property census
cooked: works — BakedStateMachines/AnimNodeProperties are cooked runtime data
hazards: Response includes graphsAvailable:false for cooked so agents do not try graph endpoints next

name: add_anim_state_machine
purpose: Create a state machine node inside an AnimBP's AnimGraph — the entry point of AnimBP authoring, currently impossible
hazards: AnimGraph editor module must be LOADED (LoadModule defensively) — linked no; load-order unverified
graphId must be an AnimGraph — enforce via schema class name AnimationGraphSchema

name: add_anim_state
purpose: Add a state to a state machine graph; returns the state's bound animation graph id for existing graph endpoints
hazards: AnimGraph editor module must be LOADED — linked no; load-order unverified
graphId must be a UAnimationStateMachineGraph — class-name check

name: add_anim_transition
purpose: Create a transition between two states, returning the transition node and its K2 rule graph id
hazards: Same route as the connect_pins schema fix — schema auto-creates the transition node
Refuse from==to (self-transitions need conduit/alias design, out of scope)
AnimGraph module loaded, not linked

name: connect_pins
purpose: ConnectPinsChecked must use the graph's own schema instead of the hardcoded K2 CDO
prevents: Roadmap: UAnimationGraphSchema overrides never run; state-to-state never spawns transitions
hazards: Silent-ignore today: non-K2 schemas silently get K2 semantics (MifBridgeCommon.cpp:1494,1509,1515)
BreakPinLinks also routed through the K2 CDO (:1505-1506) — the fix must reroute it too

name: add_component
purpose: parentName resolves inherited-SCS and native parents, not just own SCS
prevents: Roadmap blocking: attaching to a Character's Mesh hard-fails today (own-SCS-only lookup)
hazards: Error on miss must enumerate all three scopes searched (own SCS, ancestor SCS, native CDO)

name: list_components
purpose: Include inherited and native components (source field) so agents can discover legal parents
engineApi: Ancestor SCS walk + CDO GetComponents; read-only walk of UPROPERTY data, no new API
cooked: refuses — SCS read on uncooked UBlueprint (unchanged)

name: list_variables
purpose: Add scope=local (+function) to list_variables, rename_variable, remove_variable, set_variable_default — locals are write-once and invisible today
cooked: refuses — graph mutation (list read refuses like member path)
prevents: Roadmap: locals are currently write-once and invisible
hazards: Local default-write pattern: FindLocalVariable -> Entry->Modify() -> Desc->DefaultValue -> MarkStructural
UStruct* scope must come from the generated UFunction (GeneratedClass->FindFunctionByName)

name: rename_function
purpose: Document that rename_function already renames macro graphs (any graphId via RenameGraph); add graphType response field; remove_function stays as-is
hazards: remove_function searches FunctionGraphs only (MifBridgeFunctions.cpp:93) — superseded by remove_graph, keep for compat
